title: feat(maps): multiple maps or a game mode per draft/comp (#92)
body:
Closes #92

## What changed
- A draft or comp now has one of: any map, a single map, several maps, or a game mode (Domination, Convoy, Convergence). Maps and a mode cannot be mixed.
- The map picker has a "Select several maps" toggle and game mode buttons. Picking a mode clears maps, and picking maps clears the mode.
- The selection shows on the comp settings card, in saved lists, and in the comp image.
- Position Board: several maps show a tab strip above the map image. Each tab keeps its own hero positions. The hero list is shared. A game mode shows the mode name and icon, turns positions off, and shows "Pick a map to place positions."
- Old data keeps working: saved comps with `mapId` load as one map, and old board records load unchanged. Import/export and backups carry the new selection and per-map positions.

## Tests
`npm run check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` pass. Playwright: 207 pass. `boardDrawings.spec.ts:668` (zone drag, 1 px) fails on `main` too and is unrelated.
